    allies = observation.get('allies', [])

    target_positions = []

    if resources:

        target_positions.append(nearest_resource)

                    if val < min_value:
                        min_value = val
                        min_territory = (nx, ny)
        if min_territory:

        # Default move: stay or random safe move
